provider.title: DeepSeek（峰谷计价）
provider.description: DeepSeek Responses API，支持峰谷计价与关闭、低、高、最大四档思考。

changelog.0.3.0:
- Add independent web search and URL reading switches for `deepseek-flash` in the fourth section of the endpoint editor. Both default to off and can be used alongside existing function tools.
- Keep signed web results in the conversation history so follow-up questions can refer to previously read pages.
- Order reasoning levels from Off through Low and High to Max. New DeepSeek endpoints start with Off.
changelog.0.2.2:
- Support Cortico 0.2.13. Use its built-in connection pricing editor for custom quotes and keep official peak/off-peak rates in a separate panel.
- Pin development checks and WebUI builds to Cortico 0.2.13 without a sibling checkout.
changelog.0.2.1:
- Identify peak/off-peak pricing in the provider title and all four reasoning tiers in its descriptions.
- Correct the README requirement to provider contract 6.
changelog.0.2.0:
- Target Cortico 0.2.1 and provider contract 6.
- Rename browser contributions, imports and bundles to WebUI.
- Add extension self-description and publishing guidance; keep tags empty to match the official index.
changelog.0.1.6: - Last release using the previous Cortico extension contract.
